claim: Zillow Background Check Tale of Caution (Do Not Use)
summary: I used Zillow’s background check to screen my tenants last year and what a total joke their screening is. The tenant that Zillow’s background check told me had a 755 credit score, 100% on time payments, and no evictions, in reality, has an eviction from 2019 with a $4k+ default judgment, multiple arrests with convictions prior to moving in, and since moving in, has gotten arrested a bunch ...
